meta.description: Item TYPE definitions (ItemID) with world placement counts; world instances are in instances/*.json

identity_rules.ItemTypeID: ItemID.item_ID / Pickupable.item_ID (type, shared by many objects)
identity_rules.WorldObjectID: census id = namespace + FNV-1a(scene/path#kind) with [siblingIndex] for duplicate names (src/Shared/WorldIdentity.cs)
identity_rules.SaveKey_world: ItemDay_<GameObject name> (respawn day), Item_<GameObject name> (unique/money) - keyed by NAME, not path
identity_rules.RuntimeEntityID: dropped objects are renamed 'dropped' by the game and have no scene identity
